copy.headline: Those brown bananas on your counter are worth $8.
Smoothie base.
items: Peel, freeze in a bag. One frozen banana replaces ice AND adds sweetness to any smoothie.
A bag of 4 frozen bananas lasts a month and saves you from buying smoothie mix ($6–8/bag).

copy.headline: Pancake binder.
copy.body: Mash one banana + 2 eggs + pinch of cinnamon. That's the entire batter. No flour needed. 3-ingredient pancakes in 10 minutes. Kids don't know the difference.

copy.headline: Oatmeal sweetener.
items: Mash half a banana into your oatmeal instead of sugar, honey, or maple syrup.
It dissolves into the heat and sweetens naturally.
You just saved a squeeze of $9 maple syrup.

copy.headline: Ice cream.
copy.body: Freeze sliced bananas. Blend frozen. That's it. It's creamy, it's sweet, it's ice cream. No dairy. No sugar. No machine.
copy.ctaLine: fond alerts you before bananas go bad — so you freeze them instead of trashing them. Link in bio.
